segs: The names of the months came up from Babylonia
(כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בִּירוּשַׁלְמִי רֹאשׁ הַשָּׁנָה א, ב
(as stated in the Yerushalmi, Rosh Hashanah 1:2,
for we do not find in Scripture
only the name of its number:
except that this month is called,
regarding the building of the Beis HaMikdash, "Ziv."
"In the month in which the radiant ones of the world were born" —
who holds that the Avos were born in Nissan.
they had already been born, in Nissan.
it would have been more fitting
since the Avos were born in it.
the Avos are called "the radiant ones of the world"
because they illuminate and shine upon the "world,"
which is the attribute of Malchus,
For the purpose of heaven and earth
was so that there would be
who would recognize the power of His kingship.
And when Adam HaRishon was created,
הָיָה נִצְרָךְ לִהְיוֹת הַכֹּל כְּמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל
everything was meant to be like Yisrael;
and afterward, when he became corrupted,
for whose sake the world was created,
And the Avos are the ones who shine upon and illuminate the "world,"
that extends from end to end,
from Kesser Elyon down to Malchus.
And of Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom,
which is called "the letter of truth"
רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת וַיִּקְרָא, חֵלֶק ג ב, א)
at the beginning of Parashas Vayikra, Zohar III 2a),
and it is a chariot for the attribute of Tiferes.
"And the tiferes — this is Mattan Torah."
And Yaakov is a chariot for this attribute,
as we say (in the zemer for Seudah Shelishis):
That is, the radiance of the sun,
וְיַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם נִקְרָא שֶׁמֶשׁ
and Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom, is called "sun"
"'He cast down from heaven to earth
if not because of the image of Yaakov
that is engraved upon My Throne?' etc."
And Yaakov is called "the glory of Yisrael"
because he had the "likeness of a man,"
like Adam HaRishon before the sin.
And after his name was called Yisrael,
were called by the name Yisrael,
(בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת תּוֹלְדוֹת, סג, ג)
(Bereishis Rabbah 63:3, at the beginning of Toldos);
and all the Avos are called "the radiant ones of the world,"
which is the attribute of Malchus.
וְכֵן ו׳ כּוֹלֵל כָּל הַשֵּׁשׁ מִדּוֹת
And likewise the vav includes all six attributes,
for which the Avos are a chariot.
and he is the vav, the letter of truth,
which is "the secret of the Avos and their totality,"
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בַּזֹּהַר חֵלֶק א רז, א)
cited in the name of Rav Hai Gaon
that the letter vav is so called
from the term "the hooks of the pillars,"
and its shape too is like the shape of the hooks of the pillars,
And this is the vav, the middle bar,
שֶׁהוּא מַבְרִיחַ מִן הַקָּצֶה אֶל הַקָּצֶה
which extends from end to end,
from Kesser Elyon to the attribute of Malchus,
וְכֵן יוֹסֵף נִקְרָא גַּם כֵּן ו׳
And likewise Yosef is also called vav,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א קפב, ב)
as stated in the holy Zohar (Zohar I 182b):
"And the two of them go together,
for the two go together," etc.
That is, Yosef is the small vav,
the vav of the spelled-out letter,
"for all that is in heaven and on earth"
"that holds on to heaven and earth,"
for it connects the attribute of "heaven,"
And Yaakov is the large vav,
that extends from the end, etc.,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ב יד, ב)
as stated in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 14b):
for Yaakov, in the secret of Daas."
And Daas is the inner aspect of Kesser Elyon.
וְכֵן כָּל חוֹדֶשׁ נִבְרָא בְּאוֹת מְיוּחָד
And likewise each month was created with a particular letter,
which lists the month of Iyar:
"He made the letter vav king over thought, etc.,
and Iyar in the year," etc.
And likewise in the days of the Sefirah,
there always begins on Rosh Chodesh Iyar
which corresponds to the attribute of Tiferes.
וְחוֹדֶשׁ אִיָּיר הוּא מְחַבֵּר חוֹדֶשׁ נִיסָן
And the month of Iyar connects the month of Nissan,
which was the beginning of the sprouting of Knesses Yisrael,
after the plague of the firstborn,
which corresponded to the tenth attribute;
וְאָז זָכוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל לְמִדַּת כֶּתֶר עֶלְיוֹן
and then Yisrael merited the attribute of Kesser Elyon —
"When you take the people out of Egypt,
תַּעַבְדוּן אֶת הָאֱלֹהִים וְגוֹמֵר (שְׁמוֹת ג, יב)
that is, Mattan Torah, which was in Sivan;
and the month of Iyar connects
the month of Nissan with the month of Sivan.
וְזֶהוּ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג נח, א)
And this is what is said in the holy Zohar (Zohar III 58a):
וְכָתַב מוֹרֵנוּ הָרַב חַיִּים וִיטַאל זַ״ל
and Moreinu HaRav Chaim Vital, of blessed memory, wrote
And in Sivan the Torah was given.
אַךְ חוֹדֶשׁ אִיָּיר לֹא מָצִינוּ טַעַם
But for the month of Iyar we find no reason
why he counted it among the four months
that are on the side of Chessed;
that connects the months of Nissan and Sivan.
That is, all the days of the Sefirah
are a preparation for Mattan Torah,
(פְּרִי עֵץ חַיִּים שַׁעַר חַג הַמַּצּוֹת א)
that on the night of Pesach the light was revealed,
and afterward, in the days of the Sefirah, they are refined
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה זָכוּ לְמַתַּן תּוֹרָה
and through this they merited Mattan Torah,
for they brought the light down below:
And the main part is in the month of Iyar,
which was created with the letter vav
that connects the months of Nissan and Sivan,
"This month shall be for you" (Shemos 12:2) was said
in Egypt on Rosh Chodesh Nissan,
it was still before the tenth plague,
and Yisrael had not yet merited
and only to Moshe and Aharon was it said,
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (שְׁמוֹת רַבָּה טו, כ)
as stated in the Midrash (Shemos Rabbah 15:20):
"Since the sanctification of the month is by three, etc.,
אָמַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ בָּרוּךְ הוּא לְמֹשֶׁה וּלְאַהֲרֹן
Hakadosh Baruch Hu said to Moshe and Aharon,
אֲנִי וְאַתֶּם נְקַדֵּשׁ אֶת הַחוֹדֶשׁ וְכוּלֵּי
'I and you shall sanctify the month,'" etc.
And so it is written in the Pesikta
and stood Moshe on one side
and Aharon on the other," etc.
But only on Rosh Chodesh Iyar,
after the plague of the firstborn,
in the aspect of Knesses Yisrael,
"the moon that receives from the sun" —
since the Avos had already been born in Nissan,
they being "the radiant ones of the world";
that is, the light of the sun,
And the essence of the radiance is Yaakov,
even when his name was Yaakov,
But only after his name was called Yisrael
אָז גַּם יִצְחָק וְאַבְרָהָם נִקְרְאוּ יִשְׂרָאֵל
were Yitzchak and Avraham too called Yisrael,
and all of them are "the radiant ones of the world."
And this is what is stated in Midrash Rabbah
(רֵישׁ פָּרָשַׁת וַיֵּצֵא, בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה סח, ו)
(at the beginning of Vayeitzei, Bereishis Rabbah 68:6):
וְכִי לֹא יָצָא מִשָּׁם אֶלָּא הוּא וְכוּלֵּי
did no one leave from there but he? etc.
When he left from there, its radiance departed,
וַתֵּצֵא מִן הַמָּקוֹם וְכוּלֵּי (רוּת א, ז)
'And she went out from the place,' etc. (Rus 1:7) —
וְכִי לֹא יָצָא מִן הַמָּקוֹם אֶלָּא הִיא וְכוּלֵּי
did no one leave the place but she? etc.
When she left from there, its radiance departed,
לֹא הָיְתָה אֶלָּא אוֹתָהּ הַצַּדֶּקֶת בִּלְבַד
where there was only that righteous woman;
where there were Yitzchak and Rivkah?" etc.
why it held back this question
until it brought the exposition regarding Naomi,
דִּגְבֵי יַעֲקֹב הָא הֲוֵי יִצְחָק וְרִבְקָה
that with Yaakov, Yitzchak and Rivkah were there;
why did it not ask this
immediately, when it expounded about Yaakov,
But at first it was possible to say
for he is the radiance of the world,
even when he was called Yaakov,
as it says, "for the sun had come" —
which is not so of Yitzchak,
until his name was called Yisrael,
וְאָז גַּם יִצְחָק נִקְרָא שְׁמוֹ יִשְׂרָאֵל
and then Yitzchak too was called by the name Yisrael,
as the Midrash Rabbah brings (Toldos, ibid.)
that he was called by the name Yisrael
the "likeness of a man" upon the Throne;
that when Yaakov left, its radiance departed.
also about Naomi, "And she went out,"
because she was a righteous woman,
with her departure the radiance left the place —
it is understandable there, regarding Naomi,
where there was only that righteous woman;
where Yitzchak and Rivkah, tzaddikim, were present,
the radiance had not yet departed
לֹא דּוֹמֶה זְכוּתוֹ שֶׁל צַדִּיק אֶחָד וְכוּלֵּי
"The merit of one tzaddik is not comparable," etc.
when Yitzchak and Avraham too were called Yisrael,
וְהֵם גַּם כֵּן בִּכְלַל תִּפְאֶרֶת יִשְׂרָאֵל
and they too are included in "the glory of Yisrael,"
the month of Iyar was called "Ziv";
for then, at the renewal of the moon,
there had already shone upon Knesses Yisrael
who are "the radiant ones of the world."
at the beginning of the building of the Beis HaMikdash,
which is called "the chamber of the beds,"
where there is the union of
Kudsha Brich Hu and Knesses Yisrael;
and therefore the month was then called "Ziv,"
for the Avos, "the radiant ones of the world," shone forth
from the light of the sun to the moon.
And it is stated in Sefer Yetzirah:
"He made the letter vav king over thought."
For it is stated in the writings of the holy Arizal
(פְּרִי עֵץ חַיִּים שַׁעַר סְפִירַת הָעוֹמֶר ז)
that the days of the Sefirah
are a rectification for the blemish of the bris;
and they wrote an allusion to this:
That is, the main purpose of the exiles
which is the root of the corruption of the serpent:
And for this there was the exile of Egypt,
which is "the nakedness of the land,"
אֲשֶׁר בְּשַׂר חֲמוֹרִים בְּשָׂרָם וְגוֹמֵר (יְחֶזְקֵאל כג, כ)
"whose flesh is the flesh of donkeys," etc. (Yechezkel 23:20);
and Yosef was sold there as a slave
to be refined in his attribute.
And there were the souls of the generation of the Flood,
which came about through this very blemish,
"They are of the generation of the Flood";
and it was decreed upon them,
And afterward, at the splitting of the Yam Suf,
Yisrael were refined in their righteousness:
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בְּשִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים רַבָּה ד, יב)
and fenced himself off from immorality,
and all the males were fenced off in his merit."
וְזֶה שֶׁאָמְרוּ בַּמִּדְרָשׁ (שׁוֹחֵר טוֹב תְּהִילִּים קיד)
And this is what is stated in the Midrash (Midrash Tehillim 114)
and in the holy Zohar (Zohar II 49a):
it saw the coffin of Yosef
That is, all Yisrael are refined
בְּמִדַּת צַדִּיק יְסוֹד עוֹלָם (מִשְׁלֵי י, כה)
in the attribute of "the tzaddik is the foundation of the world" (Mishlei 10:25):
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (בְּרֵאשִׁית רַבָּה וַיְחִי צט, ד)
אִישׁ אֲשֶׁר כְּבִרְכָתוֹ בֵּרַךְ אוֹתָם (בְּרֵאשִׁית מט, כח)
"'Each according to his blessing he blessed them' (Bereishis 49:28) —
for each one of the tribes
comprises the holiness of all the tribes.
And afterward, in the days of the Sefirah,
they are refined to be "refined sevenfold,"
and principally in the month of Iyar,
which was created with the letter vav;
שֶׁהָיָה כְּמוֹ אָדָם הָרִאשׁוֹן קוֹדֶם הַקִּלְקוּל
who was like Adam HaRishon before the corruption,
וְכֵן יַעֲקֹב אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם לֹא מֵת
And likewise Yaakov Avinu, alav hashalom, did not die
for he knew nothing at all
which is to feel bodily pleasure
And the attribute of Yaakov is
וּשְׂפַת אֱמֶת תִּיכּוֹן לָעַד (מִשְׁלֵי יב, יט)
and "Truthful speech shall be established forever" (Mishlei 12:19),
that it should be so forever.
And it says, "He made the letter vav king over thought,"
for this is a task even for the great,
that it is counted as a great thing for Yechezkel,
שְׁלֹשָׁה דְּבָרִים אֵין אָדָם נִיצּוֹל מֵהֶם
"Three things a person is not saved from
That is, thought about what is permitted;
for when one intends only his own pleasure,
And for this the Omer comes on Pesach,
"Just as her deeds were the deeds of an animal,
so her offering is animal fodder."
That is, this blemish is the deed of an animal
when the intent is not for the sake of Heaven,
"In three things they are like animals," etc.
And they offer the animal fodder
for Yisrael have an intent in this
and there is holiness in it.
And afterward, in the days of the Sefirah,
which was created with the letter vav,
which is the letter of truth,
and "Truthful speech shall be established forever" —
that it should be so forever.
And this is the vav that connects Nissan,
which was the Exodus from Egypt from the side of Chessed,
וְהָיָה כְּנֶגֶד אַבְרָהָם אָבִינוּ עָלָיו הַשָּׁלוֹם
and corresponded to Avraham Avinu, alav hashalom,
who was the beginning of the light
"'Let there be light' — this is Avraham" —
to the culmination, the month of Sivan,
freedom from the Angel of Death,
and presumably also from the yetzer hara,
which is the Angel of Death,
and then they brought the words of Torah,
which is "Torah is light," down to earth.
And this is "He made the letter vav king over thought":
which is a great thing even for Yechezkel;
that is, that they should know nothing at all
and everything will be in holiness.
And this is the main task in this month:
"to purify us from our husks and our impurities,"
which is the root of the serpent's corruption,
who instilled in man the sensing of pleasures.
And when we rectify this in this month,
And this month begins in the third week,
corresponding to the attribute of Tiferes,
שֶׁבָּזֶה הַחוֹדֶשׁ הָעִיקָּר הֲכָנָה לְמַתַּן תּוֹרָה
for in this month is the main preparation for Mattan Torah,
